scope: Each of the ten requested categories has original-source catalog, source-family or directly observed entry evidence on both exact selected discs, plus explicit unknowns and next evidence. This establishes the Phase 0 coverage inventory. catalog_complete remains false: exhaustive semantic IDs, story variants, complete progression, format recovery and behavior validation are later-phase work.

verification.category_coverage: Exactly twenty unique profile/category rows cover all ten named plan categories on both original discs. Each baseline anchor has a concrete category relationship and passed original-source evidence, linked to an independently verified projection, source catalog or captured entry.
verification.source_and_execution_counts: Complete measured physical/source-slot surveys, 730/205 non-dummy field data pairs, observed fields14/290 and15/290, 17/12 movie selectors, 305 audio-signature slots per source, shared Battle and card-menu source families, and 32 scoped original execution observations are recorded separately. These counts are not unique semantic content totals.
verification.open_work: Every partially enumerated row retains unknown IDs, behavior or variants and the next required original evidence. The exhaustive catalog flag remains false. Successful direct battle readiness, actual save/load, complete story progression and full formats are not Phase 0 inventory claims.
verification.original_review: Both-source source bytes and instruction relationships were measured from supplied originals. Captures were actually viewed, including negative/limited outcomes. Source mapping is not inferred from source filenames or another game project.
verification.public_gate: Pinned Nix Debug gate passed matrix/schema/source audit/format/build and all three CTest suites with 71 tooling tests, including seven adversarial baseline-inventory cases. Public metadata fixtures test consistency and do not establish original behavior.

artifacts.scope: Passed 99-file matrix/schema/format/Debug build and CTest command record.
Exact 71 tooling-test and three CTest suite results.
Exact reviewed inventory/observation/finding hashes and per-category original anchors.

limitations: This verifies that the original-game coverage inventory exists; it does not claim exhaustive semantic enumeration or gameplay implementation.
Native runtime, editor, full data formats, scripts and behavior remain later-phase work.
HLE/reference instrumentation limitations and unobserved ordinary progression remain explicit in each finding.
